Here's the relevant snippet from the [pydantic source](https://github.com/pydantic/pydantic/blob//pydantic/_internal/_generate_schema.py#L542):

                            raise PydanticSchemaGenerationError(

In the case of using `from __future__ import annotations`, `extra_annotation` will be the string `dict[str, int]` so we raise the schema generation error.

### Example Code

    __pydantic_extra__: dict[str, int]
